# 完整动效参考导航

来源LottieFiles/motion-design-skill，保留15份独立参考的完整方法表与推理步骤，MIT见 [许可](../../LICENSES/LottieFiles-MIT.txt)。适配含条件说明、弹簧系数和stagger算术修正。质量总入口使用本包 [QA](../../modules/qa.md)。

| 要解决什么 | 阅读 |
|---|---|
| 动作层级/时间编排 | [choreography](director/choreography.md) |
| 语境改变时怎么变 | [context-adaptation](director/context-adaptation.md) |
| 目的与选择逻辑 | [core-philosophy](director/core-philosophy.md)、[decision-framework](director/decision-framework.md) |
| 重量、预备、随动 | [disney-principles](director/disney-principles.md) |
| 情绪与运动性格 | [emotion-mapping](director/emotion-mapping.md)、[motion-personality](director/motion-personality.md) |
| 叙事弧线 | [narrative-structure](director/narrative-structure.md) |
| 入退场 | [entrance-exit](patterns/entrance-exit.md) |
| 持续环境 | [ambient-continuous](patterns/ambient-continuous.md) |
| 多元素 | [multi-element](patterns/multi-element.md) |
| 状态反馈 | [state-feedback](patterns/state-feedback.md) |
| 选属性与缓动 | [property-selection](reference/property-selection.md)、[timing-easing](reference/timing-easing-tables.md) |
| 排错 | [troubleshooting](reference/troubleshooting.md) |

这些文档的强措辞要结合其UI/微交互语境阅读。例如100–400ms是动作段而非视频镜头长度；opacity-only、匀速、静止、硬切在适当内容中都成立。民族文化/颜色情绪不是普世定律。不能用源文中的限额替换作者当前明确要求。
